fusions.name: Staghorn Threshold
fusions.desc: Grows a reef 5 tiles long ahead of you for 8 seconds. It deals 26 damage that ignores armour to each enemy that crosses it and leaves that enemy [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Reach From the Crevice
fusions.desc: Lashes an arm at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Garden at the Den
fusions.desc: Arranges a reef garden where you stand. For 9 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Overgrown at Rest
fusions.desc: The moment your health is full, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health covers you for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
